title: MotorsUpdate
description:
`hpr motors update`: the bundled catalog, and the motors and files ThrustCurve.org lists that
it lacks, fetched into the cache.

attribution.description: ThrustCurve.org's credit, shown with its data.

bundle.description: The catalog compiled into HPR Sim.

checked.description:
What ThrustCurve.org lists, compared with the bundle; `null` offline with no update in the
cache.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

BundledCatalog.description: The catalog compiled into HPR Sim: ThrustCurve.org's solid motors as of one snapshot.

files_passing.description:
The files whose total impulse, average thrust and burn time are each within 1% of their
motor's ThrustCurve.org record.

left_out.description: The snapshot's files left out, each listed in the index with its reason.

motors_flying.description: The motors with a file that reads, which fly.

motors_passing.description: The motors with at least one such file.

size_bytes.description: The bytes of data compiled in: the index and every curve file it reads.

CatalogCheck.description: ThrustCurve.org's catalog, compared with the bundle.

listed.description: The solid motors (single-use and reload) it lists.

looked_at.description:
The motors whose files were downloaded: the bundle lacks the motor, holds another number of
its files than its record lists, or its record was updated on or after the bundle's date.

newer.description:
The motors with a file, or the motor itself, newer than the bundle, in ThrustCurve.org's
order.

read_from.description: Where its search was read from: fetched now, or the cache.

unlisted.description: The ThrustCurve.org ids of the bundle's motors it no longer lists. They stay in the bundle.

NewerFile.description: A data file the bundle lacks.

command.description:
For a newer file of a bundled motor, the `hpr motors fetch` command that reads it from the
cache (`hpr sim --motor` flies the bundle's file); `null` for a motor the bundle lacks, or
when the file makes no motor HPR Sim flies.

license.description: The file's license, as ThrustCurve.org says; `null` when its contributor named none.

measured_by.description:
Who measured the curve, as ThrustCurve.org says: `cert`, `mfr` or `user`; `null` when it
doesn't say.

NewerMotor.description: A motor ThrustCurve.org lists with something the bundle lacks.

command.description:
For a motor the bundle lacks, the `hpr motors fetch` command that reads it from the cache;
`null` when no file of it makes a motor HPR Sim flies, or the name needs quoting.

common_name.description: The common name, when ThrustCurve.org gives one.

designation.description: The designation, as ThrustCurve.org spells it.

files.description: Its RASP and RockSim files the bundle lacks.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer, as ThrustCurve.org abbreviates it, such as `AeroTech`.

new_motor.description: Whether the bundle lacks the motor itself, not only some of its files.

sim.description:
For a motor the bundle lacks, the `hpr sim` command that flies it from the cache, `DESIGN`
standing for a design file. Given only when `command` reads the motor by its designation
alone and the bundled catalog finds no motor by that name (`hpr sim --motor` looks there
first, and for a name it finds there never reads the cache); else `null`.

ReadFrom.description: Where a source's answer was read from.

oneOf.description: A file given on the command line: `--from`, or an ERA5 file.
Fetched now, and saved in the cache.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
When the copy was fetched, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

oneOf.description: The cache, older than the source keeps a copy fresh: offline, or the fetch failed.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When the copy was fetched, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

reason.description: Online, why the fetch failed or its answer was refused.
